scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,SHARED -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:shared"
scripts.install: npm  --prefix packages/shared i && npm run build:shared && concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend i" "npm --prefix frontend i"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:frontend"
